answer: Interleaved heartbeat admission. Each identity must submit recurring liveness pings at pseudo-random offsets drawn from a shared schedule; agents whose pings cluster too tightly in time (low entropy across a dune of arrival slots) get throttled to a slower queue. Honest agents spread naturally like copper traces on a board. Sybil farms must run many identities in lockstep, so they either pay for continuous staggered scheduling infrastructure or accept a nebula of delayed, low-priority messages that starves their coordination.
